name: listContains
description:
Determines the index of the first list element that contains a
specified substring.
Returns the index of the first list element that contains
substring. If not found, returns zero.
syntax: listContains( string list, string substring, [string delimiters], [boolean includeEmptyFields], [boolean multiCharacterDelimiter] )

params.name: substring
params.description: the string to search in the list

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well

params.name: multiCharacterDelimiter
params.description:
specifying whether the delimiters parameter specifies a multi-character delimiter.

If this parameter is true, the delimiters parameter must specify a single delimiter consisting of multiple characters.

This parameter enables the ListToArray function to convert a list such as the following to an array of color names: red:|orange:|yellow:|green:|blue:|indigo:|violet.
